# Vendored ch58x PAC

`ch58x-hal` main requires `ch58x` 0.4.0, which is not published on crates.io.
This is the crate generated by [ch32-rs](https://github.com/ch32-rs/ch32-rs)
(`./scripts/generate.sh ch58x`, svd2rust 0.37.1) from upstream `main` (9b4ee66) plus these
SVD fixes, merged locally as ee45122:

- TMR0..3 FIFO registers writable: https://github.com/cr1tbit/ch32-rs/tree/fix/ch58x-tmr-fifo
- R16_POWER_PLAN fields writable, RB_PWR_LDO_EN: https://github.com/cr1tbit/ch32-rs/tree/fix/ch58x-power-plan

Replace with `ch58x = { version = "0.4.0", ... }` in Cargo.toml once it is published
with these fixes.
